entities.name: Gaelic Resurgence & Decline of the Pale
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Gaelic recovery beyond the Pale, the great Gaelic lordships (O'Neills, O'Donnells, Fitzgeralds of Desmond and Kildare), the shrinking of English authority to the Pale around Dublin, and the Fitzgerald supremacy as Lords Deputy.
